subject: Renewal struct: staggered multi-year + windowed burst & escape-hatch
messages:
From: Jill Harper <jill.harper@atlashealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: options for multi-year commit + quarterly burst windows

Hi Hannah,

We're up for renewal in July and we want to explore a structure that balances predictability with capacity to absorb spikes during seasonal launches. Our procurement/legal teams prefer multi-year commitments, but we need quarterly burst windows (for product launches) and an escape hatch for unexpected budget constraints.

Specifically: can you share a sample structure that includes a 24-month base commit, quarterly burst allowances, and an auto-renew opt-out clause? We'd also like co-terming with one of our analytics vendors if possible.

Timeline: Procurement wants a negotiated term sheet by end of May so we can route to legal in June.

Thanks,
Jill Harper
Head of Platform Ops
Atlas Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: options for multi-year commit + quarterly burst windows

Hi Jill — great to hear from you. Happy to map a pragmatic structure. High-level proposal attached (redwood-renewal-draft-v3.pdf). Key points: 

- Base: 24-month committed token/year with quarterly true-up windows.
- Burst windows: predefined burst credits each quarter (2x baseline for up to 7 days) and one emergency burst per year.
- Escape hatch: 30-day notice window at renewal anniversary with a reduced break fee (pro-rated) to protect both sides.
- Auto-renew: default on, but procurement can opt-out at renewal with 60 days' notice (we'll add a formal opt-out appendix).
- Co-terming: we can align effective date to your analytics vendor by applying a pro-rated first-quarter true-up and consolidated invoice.

Next steps: I'll loop in Karthik for pricing floor and Marissa for legal/contract playbook. Can you confirm the primary procurement contact so we can share a draft DocuSign?

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0126

Subject: Re: Renewal struct: pricing floor + opt-out mechanics

Quick note on pricing mechanics:

- For multi-year alignment we'll offer a 7% effective discount off list if Atlas commits to 24 months with quarterly true-ups. Discount phases down after year 1 if usage drops more than 30%.
- Escape hatch as proposed: 30-day notice with a 10% pro-rated break fee (can discuss a cap).
- Auto-renew opt-out: require 60 days notice prior to renewal date; if notice given after that, apply a one-time administrative fee equivalent to one month's committed spend.

HubSpot: I've linked the draft quote to HS-123456. Hannah — once procurement confirms the contact, I can generate the DocuSign envelope with those clause placeholders.

– Karthik

Hannah — thanks, this looks promising. Procurement is procurement@atlashealth.com (copied). A couple clarifications from legal/procurement: 

1) SOC 2 and data-handling clauses — we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a standard data-retention SLA.
2) Can the escape hatch be limited to financial distress only, or broader? We prefer narrowly defined triggers.
3) DocuSign: procurement prefers a single envelope with contract + SOW and an exhibit for burst metrics.

If you can include clause language for the escape triggers and SOC2 evidence in the DocuSign, procurement can review within 72 hours.

Jill

Looping in some operational guardrails we should include in the SOW/exhibit: 

- Capacity allocation: reserve a baseline pool for Atlas in the Dedicated cluster with automated burst throttles to prevent noisy-neighbor impact.
- SLA credits: if we miss sustained throughput SLAs during a scheduled launch (as defined in exhibit), Atlas receives token credits equal to 5% of that month's committed token value.
- Implementation timeline: we need 4 weeks to provision dedicated shards if Atlas opts for reserved capacity.

Attachment: ops-checklist.xlsx (workback schedule + provisioning checklist). I'll drop a DocuSign stub link into the shared drive for legal redlines.
